name: application-event-countdown-hero
title: Event Countdown Hero
description: Headline event countdown components with a live days/hours/minutes timer and an RSVP action, for launch and conference pages.
useWhen: Headline event countdown components with a live days/hours/minutes timer and an RSVP action, for launch and conference pages.
avoidWhen: Avoid event countdown hero when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Event Countdown Hero uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
